name: Having The Right Attitude
overview: Scripture teaches that having the right attitude begins with a heart trained to follow God's ways from youth, ensuring lasting faithfulness as seen in Proverbs 22:6. Believers must choose to serve God wholeheartedly, rejecting divided loyalties, as Jesus emphasizes in Matthew 6:24. This right attitude involves obedience to God above all, demonstrated by the apostles in Acts 5:29, and a transformed mind that discerns and embraces God's perfect will according to Romans 12:2. The evidence of such an attitude is the fruit of the Spirit, including love, joy, peace, and faith, highlighted in Galatians 5:22, all grounded in the saving love of God through Christ in John 3:16.
